This is a role where consistency, reliability and attention to detail are highly valued. What You’ll Be Doing Managing purchase orders and maintaining procurement records Monitoring supplier confirmations, delivery dates and order status Tracking shipments and following up on outstanding deliveries Maintaining accurate information within SAP and other business systems Processing invoices in our SAP Concur system Creating inbound deliveries and supporting logistics coordination activities Processing procurement and logistics-related documentation Preparing and updating spreadsheets, reports and operational data Liaising with suppliers and internal teams to resolve routine operational issues Supporting the Procurement Manager with day-to-day administrative activities Ensuring procurement and supply chain processes are completed accurately and on time What We’re Looking For For this role, attitude and approach are more important than extensive experience. We’re looking for someone who takes pride in doing a good job, enjoys organised work and is willing to become a trusted part of the team over the long term. You may be an early-career professional looking for your first permanent office-based role or someone with previous administration, logistics or operational support / administrative experience who enjoys structured responsibilities and wants stability within satisfying role. Given the significant investment within this role, we are looking for someone who is motivated to build a long-term career in this position . We are seeking an individual who can commit to the role for a minimum of two years , with the ideal candidate seeing themselves making a lasting contribution, in this role, over many years beyond. You’ll Likely Be Successful If You Have excellent attention to detail Enjoy working accurately and following established processes Are organised, methodical and dependable Are comfortable working with spreadsheets and business systems Follow tasks through to completion and do not give up easily when challenges arise Can manage routine activities consistently and accurately Are comfortable working independently once trained Take ownership of your responsibilities and can be trusted to deliver quality work Enjoy supporting colleagues and contributing to overall team success Have a positive attitude and willingness to learn Preferred Background MBO+, HBO or equivalent practical experience Previous experience in administration, operational support, logistics coordination, procurement support, or supply chain administration would be advantageous but absolutely not essential Comfortable working with Excel and business systems SAP experience would be beneficial but is not essential Fluent English language skills Dutch language skills would be an advantage but not required Ability to work in the Netherlands without company sponsorship A university degree is NOT required for this position. Full training will be provided for the right candidate. Why Join Mindray? At Mindray, you’ll join a global healthcare technology company where your contribution genuinely matters. We are looking for someone who wants to become a valued and dependable member of our team. In return, we offer a supportive environment where you can learn, develop confidence in your role and build long-term stability. ✓ Competitive salary and benefits package ✓ Hybrid working with up to 2 days working from home each week ✓ Comprehensive onboarding and training ✓ A supportive and collaborative team environment ✓ The opportunity to work for a global healthcare technology leader ✓ A stable role with long-term security ✓ An international working environment ✓ The chance to contribute to products that help improve patient care around the world Is This Role Right For You? This Role Could Be a Great Fit If You Are looking for your first permanent professional role Have recently completed vocational education and want to gain practical business experience Enjoy organisation, administration and coordination Take satisfaction from completing tasks accurately and efficiently Like working within structured processes and systems Want a stable role where you can make a meaningful contribution as part of a team This position is focused on operational coordination and administration NOT supply chain project management, strategic supply chain planning or rapid career progression. We are looking for someone who enjoys being a reliable, trusted member of the team and who takes pride in keeping things running smoothly every day. Ready to Apply? Join Mindray and help us bring better healthcare to more people around the world.

review_candidates.title: Principal Operational Readiness Engineer
review_candidates.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com. What You’ll Do CoreWeave is scaling a portfolio of mission-critical data center infrastructure to support the performance, reliability, and speed required for AI and high-performance computing workloads. Our teams partner across design, construction, commissioning, networking, and operations to bring new capacity online safely and at scale. The Principal Operational Readiness Engineer will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for stabilizing and driving execution of complex data center projects across CoreWeave’s infrastructure portfolio. About The Role This role is focused on design compliance, operational readiness, and cross-functional coordination across all phases of design, construction, commissioning, fit-out, and operational handoff. The Principal Operational Readiness Engineer will perform deep operational and technical reviews of projects to identify gaps in process execution, design validation, construction coordination, turnover readiness, and quality assurance practices. You will evaluate whether critical infrastructure systems, construction activities, commissioning efforts, and operational handoff procedures are being executed in accordance with project requirements, standards, and best practices. This individual must be comfortable rapidly assessing current-state execution, identifying risk, and driving actionable mitigation and recovery plans to resolution. In This Role, You Will Perform deep operational and technical reviews of active projects to identify gaps in design validation, process execution, construction coordination, turnover readiness, and quality assurance. Assess whether critical infrastructure systems, construction activities, commissioning efforts, and operational handoff procedures are being executed in accordance with project requirements, standards, and best practices. Identify deficiencies, breakdowns in coordination, incomplete validations, and missing controls that could impact schedule, reliability, scalability, or operational readiness. Develop and drive corrective action, mitigation, and recovery plans through resolution for distressed or high-risk infrastructure projects. Partner closely with Design, Construction, Operations, Network Engineering, Commissioning, and external contractors to improve coordination, strengthen execution discipline, and ensure projects are delivered to CoreWeave’s operational and technical standards. Review project documentation including construction drawings, MEP designs, RFIs, submittals, schedules, turnover packages, and change orders to validate project readiness and execution quality. Monitor project dependencies, sequencing, and critical path risks across large-scale data center build and fit-out programs. Support the successful turnover of projects into operations by validating readiness, identifying gaps, and driving issue resolution before handoff. Who You Are Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline. 15+ years of experience in data center design, construction, commissioning, or operational readiness within mission-critical environments. Strong technical understanding of mechanical and electrical infrastructure systems including power distribution, cooling systems, controls, generators, UPS systems, and critical plant operations. Proven experience managing distressed or high-risk infrastructure projects and driving corrective action plans to successful completion. Demonstrated ability to rapidly assess active project sites, identify execution risks, and develop mitigation and recovery strategies. Deep knowledge of construction sequencing, scheduling, turnover planning, and fit-out coordination for large-scale data center projects. Demonstrated experience coordinating across design teams, general contractors, commissioning agents, vendors, and operations organizations. Strong understanding of project scheduling methodologies, construction dependencies, and critical path management. Experience reviewing and interpreting construction drawings, MEP designs, RFIs, submittals, and change orders. Proficiency with project management and scheduling tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar platforms. Ability to lead technical issue resolution and drive decision-making across multiple stakeholder groups in dynamic project environments. Preferred Professional Engineer (PE), PMP, or commissioning-related certification. Experience supporting hyperscale, HPC, or AI-focused data center environments. Familiarity with commissioning processes, integrated systems testing (IST), and operational turnover procedures. Experience working across global or multi-region data center deployment programs. Knowledge of industry standards including Uptime Institute, NFPA, ASHRAE, and IEEE. Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. You love stepping into complex projects and bringing structure to chaotic environments. You’re curious about improving operational readiness and infrastructure delivery at scale. You’re an expert in mission-critical infrastructure systems, construction coordination, and project recovery execution. Why CoreWeave? About At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: Be Curious at Your Core Act Like an Owner Empower Employees Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences Achieve More Together We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! The base salary range for this role is $198,000 to $264,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). What We Offer The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave Company-paid Life Insurance Voluntary supplemental life insurance Short and long-term disability insurance Flexible Spending Account Health Savings Account Tuition Reimbursement Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health Family-Forming support provided by Carrot Paid Parental Leave Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside 401(k) with a generous employer match Flexible PTO Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations A casual work environment A work culture focused on innovative disruption California Applicants California Consumer Privacy Act Equal Opportunity & Accommodations CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) , CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com. Export Control Compliance This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.
